# Hacker News corpus: agent-building threads, 2025-05-18 to 2026-11-18

*Generated by `scripts/hn-corpus.mjs` on 2026-11-18 from the public HN Algolia API. 1052 stories with at least 50 points matched 25 queries on their title or URL; the 400 most-commented are listed here and their comment trees were fetched into the gitignored `.raw/` folder (111533 comments). About five listed threads are off-topic, matched through a URL (for example a laptop review); the theme notes skip them. Comments are third-party writing: the repo keeps links and metadata, and the theme notes quote only short attributed excerpts.*

Queries: `AI agent`, `AI agents`, `agentic`, `coding agent`, `agent harness`, `agent framework`, `agent SDK`, `building agents`, `LLM agents`, `MCP`, `Model Context Protocol`, `Claude Code`, `Codex CLI`, `Cursor agent`, `Pi coding agent`, `LangChain`, `LangGraph`, `AI SDK`, `OpenAI Agents SDK`, `Claude Agent SDK`, `tool calling`, `context engineering`, `agent evals`, `prompt injection`, `subagents`.
